headline: IIT Delhi, Walmart Global Tech sign Rs 9-crore partnership

headline: Guiding Data Allocation for Robust Subpopulation Generalization
summary: A new arXiv study looks at how machine learning models often achieve high average training accuracy while performing poorly on test data due to subpopulation shift, exploring data-centric solutions.

headline: Review Finds Gap Between Road Safety AI and Global Burden
